title: Version Gateways: Orchestration & GTM Playbook for API Variant Deprecation
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Executive summary:
This ticket is the canonical orchestration playbook for retiring legacy API variants via a gated, observable, and customer-friendly process. We call the initiative "Version Gateways": a set of temporal gates (announce -> opt-in -> migration window -> enforcement -> sunset) combined with tooling, docs, and GTM tasks that minimize customer downtime and support load.

Goals:
- Give customers clear, staged progression with automated migration assistance where possible.
- Coordinate release notes and PRD artifacts so SDKs, Console banners, and public docs land simultaneously.
- Provide SLO-backed enforcement thresholds and rollback/hold patterns.
- Ensure cross-team readiness: Eng, DX, Support, Sales, Compliance, and Marketing.

Scope (what's in):
- Deprecation of API variants A/B/C behind Version Gateways for inference-api-v3.
- Console banners, migration guide, SDK snippets, and automated telemetry to detect usage of deprecated variants.
- A GTM comms timeline: beta customers, general announcement, developer migration webinar, final enforcement.

Out-of-scope:
- Model algorithm changes unrelated to API contract.
- Dedicated capacity contractual changes (handled by Dedicated PMs separately).

Phases & high-level timeline (draft):
1) Prep (weeks 0-4): finalize migration guide, SDK upgrade PRs, console UX mocks, release-note templates, and compliance sign-off.
2) Beta opt-in (weeks 4-8): Invite 50 high-usage customers for known-migration pathway; collect compatibility issues.
3) Public announce + 90-day migration window (weeks 8-20): visible banners, email comms, in-console migration wizard.
4) Enforcement hold (30-day hold) (weeks 20-23): requests to deprecated variants return deprecation header + warning; telemetry moves to enforcement metrics.
5) Sunset (after week 23): 404/410 responses for deprecated variant endpoints with clear migration links.

Release notes & artifacts checklist (owners):
- Release-note canonical snippet for engineering to include in PRs (owner: @Liam O'Connor). Link to snippet: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/inference-api-v3/release-notes-snippets
- SDK migration changelog entries (owner: SDK leads). Template: https://github.com/redwood/sdks/tree/main/release-templates
- Console banner copy + design assets (owner: Design - S. Martinez). Mock: https://drive.google.com/designs/version-gateways-banner

Cross-team GTM tasks (explicit owners & acceptance):
- Eng: Add deprecation telemetry event (event name: api_variant_deprecated_called) + dashboard tile (ENG-4218). Acceptance: dashboard shows daily unique customers using deprecated variants.
- Docs: Publish migration guide with step-by-step code samples and troubleshooting. Acceptance: migration guide reviewed by Eng and DX and linked in console banner.
- DX (Design + PM): In-console migration wizard that runs a sample request and offers one-click upgrade for compatible customers. Acceptance: wizard tested with beta customers.
- Support/CS: Prepare playbooks & canned responses, list of top 20 customers to proactively contact. Acceptance: first outreach complete before public announce.
- Marketing: Blog + webinar schedule and coordinated email cadence. Acceptance: blog drafted and reviewed 1 week before public announce.

Monitoring & rollback plan:
- Key metrics to watch (daily): number of calls to deprecated endpoint, number of migration wizard successes, support tickets tagged "variant-migration", and customer-reported regressions.
- Thresholds: if migration success rate < 40% after 30 days of public announce, pause enforcement and open hotfix cadence.
- Rollback: ability to re-enable legacy variant for affected customers (temporary flag controlled by platform routing) and a postmortem within 72h.

Communication timeline (draft):
- T-28 days: Private notice to affected enterprise accounts + CS playbook ready.
- T-14 days: Public blog post + docs link + SDK upgrade highlights.
- T-7 days: Console banners live, warning headers added to deprecated responses (non-blocking).
- T0: Enforcement hold begins (warnings become stricter).
- T+30 days: Enforcement finalization window.
- T+60 days: Sunset executed for any remaining requests (with final notice).

Operational runbooks & links:
- Migration runbook (step-by-step ops tasks): https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/migration-runbook-version-gateways
- Telemetry dashboard (draft): https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/variants-migration

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Do we provide automated traffic-shifting for customers that pin IP/whitelist endpoints? (Impact: eng effort for routing flags)
- Should we offer a paid migration support SKU for enterprise customers? PM to coordinate with RevOps.
- Enforcement semantics for webhook callbacks vs sync API calls (technical clarity from Eng required).

Acceptance criteria (Definition of Done):
- Migration guide published + linked in console banners.
- SDKs have upgrade snippets merged into release branches.
- Telemetry dashboard in prod and populated with >48h of data.
- GTM comms (blog, emails, webinar recording) published.
- Sunset automation ready + tested in staging and can be triggered by PM or Eng lead.

Notes / artifacts / PRs:
- Draft blog: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-version-gateways-blog
- Migration guide draft (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/migration-guide-version-gateways
- UX mocks (Figma): https://www.figma.com/file/version-gateways/console-migration-wizard
- Engineering spike / prototype PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/3782

Risk & mitigations:
- Risk: Large customers with long release cycles may be unable to migrate in 90 days. Mitigation: explicit enterprise exemption flow + dedicated migration SRE.
- Risk: SDK regressions cause cascading errors. Mitigation: SDK canary releases + nightly compatibility tests against top 20 customer prompts.

Next immediate actions (this ticket owner):
1) Lock final announce date and publish the canonical release-note snippet (by 2025-03-07).
2) Schedule a cross-functional readiness review (Eng, DX, CS, Marketing) for 2025-03-14.
3) Create sub-tickets for Console banner work (DES-2330), telemetry dashboard (ENG-4218), and docs (PM-11048).
